name: Naija Solar
description: Voice-first solar sizing in 5 Nigerian languages

paragraphs: Tell it what you own, by voice, by text, or by a photo of your room, in English, Nigerian Pidgin, Yorùbá, Hausa, or Igbo. Naija Solar sizes the exact panels, inverter, and battery you need over a real Nigerian price catalog, draws your home in 2D and 3D, and reads the result back in your language, with a voice we fine-tuned ourselves. Every model it uses is under 4 billion parameters.
🛠️ Self-hosted on Modal, scale-to-zero · 🗣️ Custom voice Shinzmann/sorotts · 🇳🇬 Built in Nigeria
🎥 The Gradio app demo · the hand-built UI walkthrough · 💻 Code on GitHub · 📣 Launch post on LinkedIn
features: About 90 million Nigerians have no reliable electricity. That is the largest access gap of any country on earth, and the nation spends roughly 14 billion dollars every year running generators to fill it. (World Bank)
More than one in three adults cannot comfortably read a vendor quote or a spec sheet. National adult literacy sits near 62 percent, and far lower in parts of the north. (World Bank data)

English shuts most people out. Nigeria is home to more than 500 languages, and tens of millions live their whole day in Hausa, Yorùbá, Igbo, or Pidgin, the very languages solar is almost never explained in.

The knowledge gap is the real wall. Even people who can afford a system stall at the same three questions: how many panels, what size inverter, which battery. The answers hide behind kVA jargon and quotes that disagree…
🎤 Voice-first input, plus type, example, and photo paths, across 5 languages.

requirements.text: Sign in and your sizings save automatically, ready to reopen and compare.
To self-host the models, modal deploy each file in modal/ (servingvllm.py, servingwhisper.py, servingtts.py, servingvision.py) and point the BUILDSMALLBASEURL env vars at the printed URLs.
